title: Path program precondition
statement: For every bit string $x$ and every configuration consisting of an optional control label, nine natural-number registers, and an optional choice bit, the precondition for the program obtained from `pathA` by replacing each choice instruction with the answer “no” holds. In particular, every register comparison used by the program compares distinct registers, every oracle call has no repeated register argument, and any input-format check required at the current instruction is satisfied.
hypotheses_covered: arbitrary configuration with an optional control label, nine registers, and an optional choice bit
